answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 161636 Country: india Title: If imam of mosque does not pray namaz of witr after namaz of Isha then can we pray namaz of Isha with this imam? Question: If imam of mosque does not pray namaz of witr after namaz of Isha then can we pray namaz of Isha with this imam? Answer ID: 161636 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 946/828/D=9/1439) It is not compulsory to offer witr salah immediately after Isha salah rather its mustahab time is the time of Tahajjud provided one is sure to get up timely. Thus you cannot object Imam sahib if he does not offer witr salah after Isha, so this cannot lead to make his Imamat makrooh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
